hebrewText: שׁ֣וֹק הַ/תְּרוּמָ֞ה וַ/חֲזֵ֣ה הַ/תְּנוּפָ֗ה עַ֣ל אִשֵּׁ֤י הַ/חֲלָבִים֙ יָבִ֔יאוּ לְ/הָנִ֥יף תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֜ וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֤י/ךָ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ לְ/חָק עוֹלָ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה

tokens.bdb: a present (as offered up), especially in sacrifice or as tribute
the breast (as most seen in front)
a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: properly, a burnt-offering; but occasionally of any sacrifice
fat, whether literally or figuratively; hence, the richest or choice part
to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.kjv: lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)

tokens.kjv: against, among, before, by, for, from, in(-to), (out) of, with. Often with another prepositional prefix.

tokens.kjv: appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree(-d), due, law, measure, [idiom] necessary, ordinance(-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.

tokens.kjv: alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-)) ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world ([phrase] without end). Compare H5331 (נֶצַח), H5703 (עַד).
